text:
Sam (Marketing): Hey team — I pushed the latest draft of the product launch post and the webinar registration flow mapping. Need quick eyes on CTAs, hero benchmark callout, and the registration UTM routing. doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/draft-v4

Priya (Growth): Taking a look now. Can we standardize the CTA so the webinar and demo CTAs are 1-click from the blog?

Evan (Product): 1-click works. We should surface the Dedicated vs Hosted comparison as a single sentence above the benchmark table. Avoid deep jargon.

Jules (SEO): Quick note — hero H1 should include "low-latency inference" and keep length < 70 chars. Also prefer /launch/dedicated-compare as canonical URL.

Lena (Design): I updated the hero graphic and added a small badge for "SLA-backed". Putting two CTA buttons: "Watch webinar" (primary) and "Request demo" (secondary) — spacing suggestions in Figma. :art:

Sam (Marketing): @Priya good call on 1-click. For UTMs I'm proposing templated params: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch&utm_content=webinar_cta`. Does that work for tracking?

Priya (Growth): Yep — but add `utm_term` for segment, eg `utm_term=platform` when pushing to platform-specific newsletters. Also ensure HubSpot form uses hidden fields to capture `campaign` and `content`.

Evan (Product): On the benchmark callout: change "10-30ms median" to "~20ms median under typical workloads" — less absolute, more honest. Also add note about quantization tradeoffs (one short sentence).

Jules (SEO): I trimmed the slug and meta description. Meta suggestion: "Run low-latency LLMs with Redwood Inference — dedicated capacity, predictable cost."

Legal Bot: Heads-up: avoid comparative claims like "fastest" unless we have a third-party benchmark. Change to "one of the lowest-latency" or cite our benchmark spreadsheet ID: BI-2025-004.

Sam (Marketing): Good catch, Legal. I'll swap to "one of the lowest-latency" and link the BI sheet.

Priya (Growth): Webinar routing: if user comes via webinar CTA, redirect to /webinar-register?source=blog and prefill hidden `campaign=dedicated_launch` and `content=webinar_cta`. For demo CTA, route to /demo?lead_source=blog and trigger `workflow: demo-nurture` in HubSpot.

Lena (Design): Could we show a micro-form modal for webinar signups (name + email) instead of leaving the page? Conversion lift is usually +12%. Mockup in Figma.

Evan (Product): Modal is okay if we keep it fast. No heavy JS bundles. Lazy-load the modal code.

Sam (Marketing): Action items: 1) Sam to update copy for Legal and SEO suggestions (today) 2) Priya to confirm HubSpot hidden fields & workflows (tomorrow) 3) Lena to attach final hero + modal mock (today) 4) Evan to add the one-line quantization note (today)

Jules (SEO): Quick QA: add structured data for article and webinarEvent (JSON-LD) — I can draft.

Priya (Growth): Also request a short pre-roll email for webinar registrants — 24 hrs and 1 hr reminders. I'll draft sequences after final copy.

Sam (Marketing): Thanks all. If nobody objects, I'll roll the updated draft into the CMS and schedule for next Tue 10am PT. React with :thumbsup: if OK.

Evan (Product): :thumbsup:

Jules (SEO): :thumbsup:

Lena (Design): :thumbsup:

Priya (Growth): :thumbsup:

Legal Bot: Approved pending minor copy tweak (changed language).

Sam (Marketing): Great — scheduling now. I'll post final CMS link once published.

Priya (Growth): Can we also add a UTM matrix in the shared doc so ops knows what to apply for ad channels? I'll add a table.

Sam (Marketing): Please do. Closing thread once CMS link live.
